mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the order of the day in most of them."
Organised violent crimes are the order of the day in most of them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a verbal noun from the verb "qara'a"."
Al-qira'ah (plural - Al-qira'at) is a verbal noun from the verb "qara'a".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to revelation of the Qur'an that occurred while Muhammad was in Makkah."
The Makkan Suwar refer to revelation of the Qur'an that occurred while Muhammad was in Makkah.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived in 30 portions of appropriately equal length for easy recitation during the thirty nights of Ramadan."
The Qur'an is derived in 30 portions of appropriately equal length for easy recitation during the thirty nights of Ramadan.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned has fulfilled that mission of preaching the message to his people."
Jesus as far as Islam is concerned has fulfilled that mission of preaching the message to his people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a literary form with some emphasis on rhythm and rhyme but distinct from poetry."
A rhymed Prose is a literary form with some emphasis on rhythm and rhyme but distinct from poetry.
